title: Outside Albany: cloned NPC names, free services everywhere, road risk by class only
body:
The world is thin outside the authored Albany chapter:
- 701 characters share 18 names; the authored Albany cast (Rowan Quill, Jamie Tanner, Hayden Hale, Reese Pryce, Emery Sloane, Blair Drake) is cloned into 41-42 other towns each.
- All 247 towns offer free rest and resupply (45 minutes to full); renown gates 1 of 33 service rules; the clock only matters for Wolf-Winter's 60-minute dispatch window.
- Road risk depends only on road class: all 261 ambient regional connectors are "high" (+3 fatigue), so a 5-minute local road costs more fatigue than an hour on the interstate.
This is a design/content item for after the starting slice is certified (ROADMAP freezes new towns until then); filing so it is not lost.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
